content.title: FAG 6207-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 35x72x17mm, Chrome Steel, Rubber Sealed, ABEC-1
content.short_description: FAG 6207-2RS single row deep groove ball bearing, 35mm bore x 72mm OD x 17mm width, chrome steel construction with rubber (2RS) seals on both sides, ABEC-1/P0 precision class.
content.long_description:
The FAG 6207-2RS is a single row deep groove ball bearing with a 35 mm bore, 72 mm outer diameter, and 17 mm width. Rings and rolling elements are manufactured from chrome steel (GCr15/52100), a through-hardened bearing steel used for standard rolling element applications. The bearing carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 25.5 kN and a static load rating (C0) of 15.3 kN, values used to calculate expected service life under rotating and stationary loads respectively.

The 2RS designation indicates rubber seals fitted on both sides of the bearing, contacting the inner ring to retain grease and restrict entry of dust, moisture, and other contaminants. This sealing arrangement is suited to applications where periodic relubrication access is limited or where the bearing operates in a moderately contaminated environment.

Precision class is ABEC-1/P0, the standard tolerance grade for general industrial rotating equipment, including pumps, motors, gearboxes, conveyors, and fans, where high-precision tolerance grades are not required. Bore, OD, and width dimensions conform to standard 62-series metric envelope sizing, allowing direct interchange with other 6207-series bearings sharing these dimensions.

Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances, operating speed, and lubrication interval against the specific application before installation. Load ratings should be checked against actual radial and axial loads expected in service, applying appropriate life calculation factors.
